blocks.x: Wealth and capital-markets clients buy judgment and pay for experience: advisors need research and portfolio context in minutes, operations need settlement and reconciliation without firefights, and compliance needs evidence without expeditions.

The workflows we industrialize here: Advisor research and prep, Reconciliation and breaks, Client reporting, Suitability and disclosure, Corporate actions processing. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Advisors assemble portfolio context from terminals, PDFs and CRM; response quality depends on prep time.
Custody, clearing and fund reconciliation produce breaks cleared by spreadsheet; month-end compresses.
Positions, performance and fees reconcile from extracts; client questions wait on report runs.
HNW records concentrate spear-phishing and exfiltration value; controls are generic, not tiered by risk.
Constrained rebalancing across tax lots hits solver limits; tax-alpha is left behind.
Suitability checks and disclosure packs assembled manually per trade; audit trails thin.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: portfolio context, research and market moves summarized with citations pre-meeting — prep time down 40-60%
reconciliation breaks matched and remediated with escalation policy — same-day clearance
positions/performance/fees unified with certified definitions — client questions answered live

risk-tiered controls for HNW data with monitoring — exfiltration paths closed
